messages:
Priya Nair: Hey team — just got my laptop but running into a few setup things. MDM enrollment completed but Docker install fails with "system extension blocked". Also VPN client needs kernel extension and the OS is asking to allow it in Security & Privacy, but I don’t see the Allow button. Anyone seen this?
Sam Ortiz (IT): welcome Priya! what macOS version did you end up with? the allow button is hidden if firmware policy blocks kernel extensions or SIP is enforced. send serial?
Priya Nair: serial CN0A9ZZ0L2Q2. macOS shows 12.6.5 (Monterey).
security-bot: Device CN0A9ZZ0L2Q2: enrolled. Compliance: pending kernel-extension approval. Company policy: kexts must be validated via the pkg signature.
Sam Ortiz (IT): I can check the policy. sometimes the MDM blocks user allow for kexts — we instead push an approved profile that whitelists _com.vendor.vpn_ kext. I’m initiating that now.
Priya Nair: thanks. after that should I reboot?
it-ops-bot: Admin elevation required to approve kernel extension prompt. New-hires workflow: open ticket "KEXT approval for <serial> — <reason>". If you need immediate dev flow, request temporary admin for 48h.
Priya Nair: would prefer admin for 48h to install dev tools. opened ticket IT-2042 with reason "install Docker and VPN for onboarding".
Ben Cho: pinging @Sam — this is me onboarding Priya to SECUREDEV stack once Docker is up.
Sam Ortiz (IT): saw IT-2042, approved temporary admin for 48h. pushing kext whitelist now. you may need to go to System Settings -> Privacy & Security to click Allow after an MDM push on Monterey. If the Allow button is missing, reboot once and check again.
Priya Nair: rebooted, still no button. Docker installer still fails with system extension blocked.
Sam Ortiz (IT): checking DEP records — device is enrolled but firmware policy was set to "Lock down kernel extension approvals" due to company MacBook firmware baseline. I’m toggling that to staged allow for this device only.
security-bot: Firmware policy change logged by Sam Ortiz for CN0A9ZZ0L2Q2. Change id fpc-7781.
Priya Nair: ok check — I see Allow button now! clicked Allow for "SecureVPN Inc."
Priya Nair: Docker Desktop installed and VPN client installed. Docker wants Rosetta for some tools; asked to install Rosetta2. should I proceed?
Sam Ortiz (IT): Rosetta is allowed for intel binaries. go ahead. remember to run the macOS security update after installs. we will automatically revoke admin after 48h.
Priya Nair: running updates now. FileVault started encrypting after enrollment and shows 3% — is that normal during installs?
Sam Ortiz (IT): yes small initial percentage is expected; encryption speed depends on disk activity and power state. keep plugged in for faster progress.
Ben Cho: awesome — once Docker is up I’ll drop the onboarding repo and a small exercise. welcome!
Priya Nair: super smooth, thanks everyone :heart:
